conventions.temperature: thickness-averaged food deg C; not resolved top surface
conventions.cold_W: food-path heat extracted into imposed cold face, positive
conventions.balance_W: ambient + deck - cold; equals storage rate in transient
conventions.covered_low_h: assumed effective h=1 to 25 C; not solved chamber/lid
conventions.airgap: uniform conduction-only gap with k_air=0.026 W/(m K)
conventions.cold: fixed outer cold ceramic 0/2 C; no TEC feedback or ceramic model
conventions.transient_energy: backward-Euler endpoint flux quadrature, food mass only
